subject.title: feat(ios): add Apple Watch voice turns

question: After the current patch-level blockers and real Watch behavior proof are addressed, should OpenClaw support a Watch-side spoken-reply voice-turn mode as part of the iOS app?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing Watch audio behavior under a protected maintainer label, so code review can identify defects but cannot decide product acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor after blockers and proof
options.body: Fix the delivery matching, i18n, and changelog blockers, add real Watch simulator or device proof, then review the feature for merge.

options.title: Defer Watch spoken replies
options.body: Keep Watch chat text-only until maintainers decide Watch audio is a supported surface.

options.title: Fold into broader Talk design
options.body: Require a cross-device Talk design before accepting Watch-side speech playback as a standalone feature.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after blockers and proof
recommendation.body: Fix the delivery matching, i18n, and changelog blockers, add real Watch simulator or device proof, then review the feature for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the paired issue and implementation and have recent current-path WatchApp history, making them the best available product-direction owner from the evidence.
